title: The Offering Bowl
text: A great bronze bowl, green with age, where pilgrims leave gifts for the Six. It is heaped with coins and rings and little carved saints, spilling over the rim onto the floor. The monks have not emptied it in years. Nobody is watching it.

options.label: Give something to the Six, and ask them to watch over the road.

outcomes.text: The Six notice, and are pleased. For a while, luck walks with you.

options.label: Plunder the bowl. Nobody is watching.
The wisest counts what is there, and reads the prayers left with it.

outcomes.text: Offerings from every House, and what each House prays for, and some of the prayers are about you.
